comment: Per-version column header patterns for secondary sale registers. Each entry lists the header tokens (normalised: uppercase, non-alphanumeric stripped) to search for when mapping columns. Multiple tokens per field are tried in order; the first match wins. Version 'v1' is the baseline format observed for FY2021-22 through FY2025-26.

v1.comment: Baseline secondary register column layout. All FYs (2021-22 through 2025-26) share this layout: Sr.No | Date | Retailer/Retailers | ID | Segment | Cat.No | Qty | MRP | Order Value | Distributor | Discount | Sub Total | Order Total | Team Member. Team Member is at column [13] or [14] depending on the FY tab format. The head dimension maps to Team Member, NOT Distributor. Net amount is read directly from the Sub Total column; the discount-carry fallback in loader.ts handles continuation rows where Sub Total is blank.
head: TEAMMEMBERNAME
TEAMMEMBER
STATEHEAD
HEAD
SALESHEAD
v1.comment_sub_total_skip: Tokens that, when found in any of the first five cells of a data row, mark it as a sub-total/summary row to be excluded. Only the first five cells are scanned to avoid false positives on amount columns.
v1.comment_header_detection: Header row must contain at least one of header_anchor_tokens after normalisation. Scan the first 20 rows. FY2024-25 has a totals row at row 0 and the real header at row 1 — the 20-row scan covers both.
